notes.content:

The new Wet Hot Summer Update for Genital Jousting brings a throbbing orgy of new content including SIX new party modes, five stylish new outfits, and a buttload of fun for up to eight players locally or online. Get ready to tangle with your friends in wild modes like Sexy Car Wash, VolleyBalls, Get Pumped and Spa Day!

[url=youtu.be/yLEjs3TJq78]WATCH THE TRAILER HERE![/url]

[h1]FAN ART COMPETITION![/h1]
Since we launched Genital Jousting on Steam Early Access late last year, the game has been purchased by nearly 200 000 players, which is pretty amazing!

[i]“Genital Jousting has exceeded all sales forecasts and expectations which, if we’re being honest, were all at zero,” noted Devolver Digital CFO Fork Parker. “But like my grandmother always said, people love them some penises and buttholes.”[/i]

We are celebrating this milestone with a [url=freelives.net/genitaljoustingfanart]GENITAL JOUSTING FAN ART CONTEST![/url]. For longtime fans and curious newcomers alike, you have until the end of July to submit us your phallic masterpieces of original fan art! Cash prizes to be won - check out the competition page for full details. 

[img]http://freelives.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/GJ-Alt-Keyart-Blank.jpg[/img]
[i]Artwork by Ben Voldman[/i]

notes.title: Walk a wiener dog as a wiener in the two-player Genital Jousting update
notes.content:
Warning: if it wasn't already abundantly clear, the trailer above is very much NSFW. 

I'm not sure about you, but I don't know many people willing to play competitive party games featuring cutesy, colorful disembodied penises. And playing Genital Jousting solo might get the job done, it's just not the same, you know?

But for those who have at least one butt to plug, the free Date Night update slid onto Steam today. It features a series of two-player oriented games including modes where you try to share a picnic, eat spaghetti, watch TV, and walk wiener dogs across a busy street. It’s pretty relatable, domestic stuff—except you’re a penis with a butt. 

A few brave PC Gamer editor's gave Genital Jousting a collective whirl when it first came out on Early Access back in November and had a good time, though I’m not sure if they’re laughing from all the fun they’re having or because something needs to fill in for the discomfort. 

Now you can do the same, but with just one other person in the room. Cool? Cool. Probably not a good idea for a first date though. Or second. Or third. Or—just make sure you're on the same page, OK?
